TemplateCatalog._comment: Editable catalog of notification template types shown in the backoffice. Add/remove entries or variables here and restart the service — no frontend rebuild. If 'Entries' is empty the service falls back to built-in defaults.

Entries.Name: Order Confirmation
Entries.Description: Sent to the customer right after they place an order.
Entries.DefaultSubject: Your {{ model.storeName }} order {{ model.orderId }} is confirmed
Entries.DefaultBody:
Hi {{ model.customerName }},

Thanks for your order {{ model.orderId }} placed on {{ model.orderDate }}.

Order total: {{ model.total }}

We'll let you know when it ships.

Entries.Name: Shipping Notification
Entries.Description: Sent when the customer's order has been dispatched.
Entries.DefaultSubject: Your order {{ model.orderId }} is on its way
Entries.DefaultBody:
Hi {{ model.customerName }},

Good news — order {{ model.orderId }} has shipped with {{ model.carrier }}.

Tracking number: {{ model.trackingNumber }}

Entries.Name: Payment Failed
Entries.Description: Sent when payment for an order fails.
Entries.DefaultSubject: Payment could not be completed for order {{ model.orderId }}
Entries.DefaultBody:
Hi {{ model.customerName }},

We could not complete payment for order {{ model.orderId }}. Please try again or use a different payment method.

Entries.Name: Order Cancellation
Entries.Description: Sent when an order is cancelled.
Entries.DefaultSubject: Your order {{ model.orderId }} has been cancelled
Entries.DefaultBody:
Hi {{ model.customerName }},

Your order {{ model.orderId }} has been cancelled. Any payment will be refunded shortly.

Entries.Name: Welcome Email
Entries.Description: Sent when a customer creates a new account.
Entries.DefaultBody:
Hi {{ model.customerName }},

Welcome to {{ model.storeName }}. We're glad to have you.

Entries.Name: Password Reset
Entries.Description: Sent when a customer requests a password reset.
Entries.DefaultBody:
Hi {{ model.customerName }},

Click the link below to reset your password:

Reset password
